name: Mam nhum
summary: A ferment of sea-urchin meat. Báo Đồng Nai says it is sweet-smelling and rich, and salty, sour, and strongly fragrant. Eat it with rice noodles, boiled meat, and hot rice. No price was printed.
origin: Côn Đảo. Báo Đồng Nai, 11 July 2025.
taste: Báo Đồng Nai says salty, sour, and strongly fragrant, and also sweet-smelling and rich.
howToEat: Use it as a condiment with rice noodles, boiled meat, and hot rice. It is not a bowl by itself on that account.
Take a jar from the daily market. A daytime hour was not printed. Check on arrival. No price was printed.
where: Chợ Côn Đảo, the daily market in town.
